categories.description: Optional categories for limiting or binning the aggregation on the `modelProperty`. If this parameter is present, it indicates that only the indicated values would be aggregated or that the results would be returned in bins (e.g. for continuous values).

description.description: Human readable description of the aggregation performed for this term.

id.description: The id of the aggregation to be used in the request.

label.description: The label for the aggregation concept being reported on.

modelProperty.description: The property in the data model on which the aggregation is actually performed. This is informative.

description: List of aggregation terms supported for this beacon. The aggregation terms detail the respective property which include the aggregation categories (e.g. all diagnoses or ageAtDiagnosis) applied when generating summaries.
